## YTD Studio 2.1.0: every word you saved, searchable

**Which file do I need?**

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `…-2.1.0-setup.exe` | Windows installer |
| `YTD-Studio-2.1.0-mac-arm64.dmg` | Macs with Apple Silicon (M1 and newer). **Most Macs from 2021 on.** |
| `YTD-Studio-2.1.0-mac-x64.dmg` | Intel Macs |
| `YTD-Studio-2.1.0-iOS-unsigned.ipa` | iPhone and iPad, installed with a sideloading tool (see the README) |
| `YTD-Studio-2.1.0-arm64-v8a-release.apk` | Practically every Android phone. **Use this one.** |
| `YTD-Studio-2.1.0-armeabi-v7a-release.apk` | Old 32-bit Android phones |
| `YTD-Studio-2.1.0-x86_64-release.apk` | Android emulator / Chromebooks |

Everything new in this release is in the **desktop app (Windows and macOS)**. The Android and iPhone apps are the same as in 2.0.

### New: Moments (⌘7 / Ctrl+7)
A new tab that turns your downloads into something you can search and quote.

- **Search inside your videos.** Find any word said in anything you downloaded, like Ctrl+F for your whole library. "Quotes" find an exact phrase. Every hit shows the line it is in, and clicking it plays the video **from that second**. The app reads the captions once (YouTube's, or the subtitle files next to a download) and keeps them on your computer. Click **Make my library searchable** once for what you already have; new downloads become searchable by themselves.
- **Ask your library (AI).** Ask a question across everything you saved: the app finds the passages that talk about it and the model answers from them, citing each moment as a button (*S2 · 04:31*) that plays it. Works with any Ollama model, local or cloud; only those passages are sent.
- **Saved moments.** Press **B** while something plays (in the player or the Stream tab) to bookmark that moment and add a note. They are listed here, shown on the video, opened right at that second, included in backups, and **export as Markdown** with links to the exact second on YouTube.
- **Ctrl+K finds what was said, too**: type a word and the palette lists where it is spoken.

### A smarter player
- **Live transcript** next to the video: the line being said is highlighted and followed, click any line to jump there, filter it to find every mention, copy it all.
- **Chapters** from the video's metadata, with the current chapter in the title bar.
- **A map under the video** with chapters, sponsor parts, your saved moments and the loop. Click anywhere to jump.
- **A–B loop**: **[** and **]** (or the loop button) repeat a part, great for music, languages and tutorials.
- **Save the part you looped** as an **MP4 clip**, an **animated GIF** or an **MP3**, cut exactly with ffmpeg into *Clips* in your downloads folder.
- **Snapshots**: **S** saves the current frame as a PNG into *Snapshots*.
- **Copy a link to this second** (youtu.be/…?t=…) for anything downloaded from YouTube.

### SponsorBlock while you watch
Sponsor reads, self-promotion and "like and subscribe" parts are now skipped **while streaming** and in the player, with a **Watch it** button to undo. Only the first four characters of a hash of the video id are sent to SponsorBlock, so it never learns what you watch. Files you downloaded with sponsors already cut are left alone. Turn it off in Settings > General.

### Also
- Settings > General: **Skip sponsors while watching** and **Make new downloads searchable**.
- Clips and downloads with sponsors cut out: their transcript and chapters are moved onto the file's own timeline, so every timestamp lands on the right moment.
- Search works inside Chinese, Japanese and Thai captions (no spaces between words) and keeps Hindi and other Indic words whole.
- AI answers render *italics*; backups include moments.
- Tabs moved by one: Moments is Ctrl+7 / ⌘7, Settings is Ctrl+8 / ⌘8 (Ctrl+, still works).

> Android: if your previous APK was signed with a different key (see the README), uninstall it before installing this one.
